notes.title: The first small fix update for Daring Academy is out!
notes.notes:
Thank you to everyone who played Daring Academy Alpha 0.0.2. This itch.io update fixes 8 issues/small bugs to help make the playing experience better to anyone.


 Fixed the Steam icon on the main menu having a random white line/splot on the side
 Fixed an issue where some names were not colored.
 Fixed helen's character side image not having her mouth opened when talking off screen
 Fixed the discord rich presence showing as morning when it was sunset in-game
 Fixed an issue where the quick menu still showed in the pre-credits and credits
 Fixed an issue where if Minty or Delilah is petted, the "textbox_bottom" image would appear as a grey Eileen
 Changed the extra screens' escape button to Backspace and disabling the Esc key and right click button, fixing an issue where if Esc was pressed, GUIs (Like the text window for characters) would hide
 Removed the achievement screen from the options in the main menu


Please remember that a Steam release will come one the game will be in a demo phase.
